stops.note: to bind, to tie, combined with ad- (to)
to bind to, to attach, from ad- and nectere
carried into French for attaching territory or property to a larger whole
stops.meaning: to attach territory or property to a larger whole

stops.note: settled as the English word for adding territory to a larger political unit
stops.meaning: to add territory to a larger political unit, or an attached building

current_meaning: to formally add territory to a larger country or state, or a building attached to a larger one
